notes: Every Clay job `chewbacca clay` answers, and the surfaces that answer it. A surface is tried only when every arg it needs was given; the fastest measured one goes first, and the next is tried when it fails or comes back truncated. ms is end-to-end wall time for one call from a shell on Caleb's Mac on 2026-10-09, load average 60 to 90 from other agents, so read them as relative, not absolute. Every write refuses without --allow-writes and a person typing the op name at a real terminal, which agent shells don't have; --dry-run prints the exact request instead and sends nothing. Writes with verified:false were derived from Clay's frontend bundle or CLI help, never sent; their first live uses print a readback.

ops.summary: Resume one of the three paused original Zeutara recovery campaigns (status active), only after a fresh read proves the incident senders are gone and all 16 holds are out of the base audience and either finished or blocklisted. Nothing but status changes, verified against provider readback.
